helpStake: stake <amount>       bank that amount as the banker
helpBet: bet <amount>         bet against the bank (0 to pass)
helpDraw: draw [p|b]           take a third card (side defaults to whoever is deciding)
helpStand: stand [p|b]          stand pat (side defaults to whoever is deciding)
helpPass: pass                 give up the bank and pass it along
punterForcedLine: note: this total leaves no choice (0-4 must draw, 6-7 must stand)
hintNone: There is nothing to advise right now
punterFive: drawing on 5 is the standard play
bankerDraw: drawing is the stronger play at this total
bankerStand: standing is the stronger play at this total
